items.title: Aryzta To Consolidate German Operations, Completes Second French Bolt-On Acquisition
items.summary: Aryzta has announced plans to consolidate its German retail and foodservice manufacturing operations at Eisleben in Germany.

items.title: Competition regulator blocks Unox deal between Unilever and Zwanenberg
items.summary: If Zwanenberg Food Group acquires the Unox and Zwan brands from Unilever, it could lead to higher prices for smoked sausages, cooked sausages, and soups, fears the Dutch competition authority, which is blocking the deal.

items.title: Maisons du Monde replaces CEO after disappointing sales figures
items.summary: Just a few months after Maisons du Monde’s financial rescue, CEO François-Melchior de Polignac is set to step down and be replaced by John Browett. The French home furnishings chain is also bringing in retail expert Marc Ténart to accelerate its recovery.

items.title: Regional Distributors Control 18.5% Of Spain’s Grocery Market, elEconomista Reports
items.summary: Spain’s regional supermarket chains are outperforming major national retailers, capturing record revenues and profits in 2025.

items.title: EU’s ‘meaty names’ ban could include meat-flavoured crisps
items.summary: Crisps could be included in the EU's 'meaty names' ban, according to the European Snacks Association. Crisps with 'meaty' names, such as roast chicken or smoky bacon, may be included within the regulation's scope.

items.title: Marks & Spencer Invests In Cutting Meat Prices To Support British Farmers

items.title: Temu promises to do better after receiving a 200 million EU fine
items.summary: Temu has submitted an action plan to the European Commission to comply with digital regulations, after the company was hit with a hefty fine in May. The proposals have been provisionally approved, and the platform has four months to implement them.

items.title: Lindt chairman rules out resignation following shock CEO exit
items.summary: Lindt & Sprüngli chairman Ernst Tanner says former CEO Adalbert Lechner's early departure was aimed at providing planning certainty, as the company begins its search for a permanent successor while ruling out his own exit and any group-wide job cuts.

items.title: Could Spanish olive oil exports to the United States be curtailed?
items.summary: Spanish olive oil could disappear from the U.S. import market. The U.S. Federal Maritime Commission is considering imposing an embargo on certain Spanish products in retaliation for Spain's refusal to allow U.S. ships involved in transporting goods to Israel to enter its ports.
